summary: Minimal, well-scoped change: the fix is one line in BookmarkStore.list with regression tests that fail on the old code, and the filter reuses the same method instead of adding a parallel code path. Existing tests still pass, so clients without `tag` are unaffected.

coverage.evidence: existing tests/test_api.py unchanged and passing; test_without_tag_lists_everything, test_out_of_range_paging_is_rejected

findings.message: Tags are compared with casefold() on every request; storing a normalised copy on write would avoid the repeated work.
findings.suggestion: Follow-up when a persistent store is introduced: keep a lower-cased tag column with an index.

findings.message: Whitespace-only tags (`?tag=%20`) are accepted and simply match nothing.
findings.suggestion: Optional: strip and reject blank tags; harmless today.

missed_scenarios: Concurrent add during paging can shift items between pages (offset paging); cursor paging would fix it, out of scope.
